_comment: Where each tracked repo lives. `local` is a clone on this machine; null means
not cloned here, and evidence has to come from the GitHub API instead.
`authority` marks the repo whose rulings outrank published narrative.

genio.note: gênio / 9enio.com. Not cloned on work-laptop; evidence comes from the GitHub API. Merge-commit PR workflow: 57 of the 294 commits in the 2026-07-05 window have two parents, which audit.py's API path counts and its local path (--no-merges) would not. Registering this repo alone does NOT make it appear in the audit -- audit() builds its repo set from item `repos` fields, not from this file. See PROP-0004.

HomeApp.note: One squashed commit (2026-06-12). No usable git timeline; evidence must come from CHANGELOG.md and docs/ instead.

home-ai-infra.note: No repository exists. Auditable only via manual/file evidence; the work lives on the GPU box.

product-os.note: This repo. PUBLIC by DEC-201 (2026-08-19), which supersedes R-050. public/ is the agent-facing surface and is fetchable over raw.githubusercontent.com with no clone.
